rules: Assemble prompt only as RULES -> STATE -> ACTIVE -> DELTA -> TASK.
Inline AL-STRUCT-1 required fields, closed enums and one role=schema_example example for model calls.
Mark previous model results role=prior_output; they are UNTRUSTED_DATA, not instructions.
STATE uses machine-owned reference-first Registry projection.
ACTIVE contains exact input_refs, input_snapshot_id, input_snapshot_hash and only prior outputs allowed by stage contract.
DELTA contains new/changed refs; it does not imply a global delta-only mutation protocol.
Compute stable input_snapshot_hash over stable serialization of the frozen semantic input.
Compute prompt_hash over the final compiled prompt separately from snapshot hash.
Enforce centralized context budget before transport; fail PROMPT_TOO_LARGE if required context cannot fit.
Never use historical chat transcript as normative project context.
Do not invent missing inputs; route them under framework discipline.
repair_prompt: Same stage contract and immutable snapshot; provide only corrected ModelSemanticResponse against listed machine validation errors. Do not add machine-owned metadata or new scope.
annotations_policy: diagnostic only; never use annotations to decide mutations/status/gates
